name: speedle
description: Turn policy documents into tested SPDL and ask Speedle authorization questions.

SPEEDLE_ENDPOINT.title: ADS endpoint
SPEEDLE_ENDPOINT.description: Speedle ADS base URL. Use the local default or enter your deployment's URL.

SPEEDLE_SERVICE_NAME.title: Service name
SPEEDLE_SERVICE_NAME.description: Speedle service name sent with every authorization check.

SPEEDLE_TOKEN.title: ADS bearer token
SPEEDLE_TOKEN.description: Optional bearer token for an ADS deployment that requires authentication. HTTPS is required when a token is used.
